summary: Mobile UI regression pass for BigFM Dubai light-theme migration. Verified readability on Radio/Lobbies/Channels, create-lobby modal no-crash, filter-chip clipping fix, and MiniPlayer play/pause wiring. All 4 requested items PASS.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Non-blocking but should be migrated for future RN Web compatibility.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.

radio_screen.tagline_DIL_SE_DUBAI_SE: rgb(148,163,184) muted slate-400 -- readable on light bg
radio_screen.track_title_Midnight_Lounge: Confirmed dark via screenshot after starting session

channels_screen.filter_chips_LANG_MOOD_VIBE: Fully visible in screenshot; maxHeight bumped to 52 and alignItems:'center' applied -- no clipping observed

lobbies_screen.create_lobby_modal: Opens without crash. Modal title 'Host a lobby', Name/Description inputs, Channel select, Mood chips, Public toggle, Cancel & Pressable 'Go live' submit all render correctly. Pressable import fix confirmed working.

mini_player.wiring: togglePlayback + nativePlay/nativePause path invoked (does not just flip zustand flag, does not crash, does not merely navigate)
mini_player.icon_state_transitions: pause (uf493) -> play (uf4c6) -> pause (uf493) on successive taps -- state change confirmed
mini_player.no_audio_session_fallback: hasPlayer() guard in place; navigates to /now-playing if no player registered

action_items: OPTIONAL: Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents' to 'style.pointerEvents' to remove React Native Web console warnings (cosmetic only, no user impact).
critical_code_review_comments: audioController singleton pattern is clean and centralized; MiniPlayer correctly guards with hasPlayer() before calling togglePlayback and falls back to /now-playing navigation.
Radio screen properly calls registerPlayer on each new segment and clearPlayer on unmount -- no stale references.
channels.tsx filterRow maxHeight 52 + alignItems:'center' provides enough breathing room for 25px chips; measured overflow of ~1.6px is not visually clipped in preview.
lobbies.tsx Pressable import added -- no undefined reference crash when opening create modal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light-theme migration for BigFM Dubai mobile is stable. Radio/Lobbies/Channels all render dark text on light background as expected. MiniPlayer play/pause is properly wired through audioController singleton and reflects state via icon changes. Deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents warnings are RN Web cosmetic and not blocking.
